run_voc2007_generate: run the voc2007 module to generate fake VOC2007 dataset files with random images and annotations
generate_trainval_archive: generate train and validation fake VOC2007 dataset archives with random JPEG images and XML annotations
generate_test_archive: generate a fake VOC2007 test dataset archive with random JPEG images and XML annotations
generate_data_for_set: generate fake VOC2007 data examples for a specified train, validation, or test set with random images and annotations
generate_annotation: generate a fake VOC2007 annotation XML file with random objects, bounding boxes, labels, and poses
